sources: https://greenwoodacrescampground.com/wp-content/uploads/2026-Overnight-Camping-Rates.png (the 2026 rate table on the reservations page)

values.note: 2026 overnight rates. In season (April 16 - October 14): water and electric $55, full hook-up back-in $60, lakefront $65, full hook-up pull-thru $70, primitive $45; $10 more on holidays. Out of season (April 1-15 and October 15-31): $50 for every hookup site, primitive $45 (the reservations page text says $40). Weekly (7+ nights) 15% off, monthly (30+ nights) 40% off. Golf carts and boats $7 a night if brought in.

fees.source: https://greenwoodacrescampground.com/reservations/ ('2026 Camping Rates' table image 2026-Overnight-Camping-Rates.png; text: 'All other sites during Spring (April 1st- April 15th) and Fall (Oct 15th- Oct 31st): Primitive- $40 per night, Water and Electric- $50 ...'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://greenwoodacrescampground.com/ ('All of our campsites come equipped with water hookups and 30-amp electricity, while many offer 50-amp service and full sewer connections'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Over 1,100 sites, over 900 of them seasonal, so under 200 are sold by the night. Overnight types: primitive, water and electric, full hook-up back-in, lakefront (two sites on Canal Street, RVs to 28 ft, water and 50-amp) and full hook-up pull-thru for big rigs.

sites.source: https://greenwoodacrescampground.com/general-info/ ('has over 1100 sites with over 900 seasonal campsites') + https://greenwoodacrescampground.com/ ('Big rig? No problem! Pull-thru sites', 'lot 13 or 14 on Canal Street ... up to 28' RVs') + /reservations/ ('Lakefront sites can accommodate up to a 28ft RV which includes water hook-up and 50 amp electric'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://greenwoodacrescampground.com/general-info/ ('You can enjoy camping from April 1 through October 31'; 'November 1-March 31: We are closed for camping'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book online on the operator's NewBook page; full payment at booking. Up to a year ahead. 3-night minimum on holiday weekends; tent stays 6 nights at most; pull-thru and lakefront sites 2 weeks at most. No group bookings. Check-in after 3 pm, check-out before 2 pm; the gate is staffed 24/7.

booking.source: https://greenwoodacrescampground.com/reservations/ (booking link to bookingsus.newbook.cloud/greenwood_acres_family_campground1; 'a 3-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. 6-night max for tent reservations'; '2-week reservation max on pull-thru & lakefront campsites') + https://greenwoodacrescampground.com/faq-overnight/ ('You can book up to a year in advance', 'there is always somebody at the gate 24/7'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://greenwoodacrescampground.com/reservations/ and /faq-overnight/ (no military discount mentioned), read 2026-10-22. The stored value came only from the Good Sam directory, so it is cleared.

note: Large family campground on 300 acres with a mile of shoreline on Goose Lake (private and spring-fed, slow boating only), with a pool, a free 9-hole golf course and weekend bands; site of the 1970 Goose Lake Rock Festival. Only seasonal campers may have overnight visitors. --Claude
summary: Operator site live with 2026 rates and a NewBook booking engine. Added fees $50 (out-of-season hookup sites) to $80 (holiday pull-thru); in season the cheapest RV site (water/electric) is $55. Confirmed 50-amp/water/sewer, 1,100+ sites with pull-throughs, season April 1 - October 31, 3-night holiday minimum; added the booking URL, 1-year window, booking notes. Cleared the directory-only military discount. Mostly seasonal: over 900 of 1,100+ sites are seasonal (seasonal waiting list, a for-sale listing of seasonal sites); under 200 sites sell by the night, still more than 1 in 10, and nights are sold online with posted rates. Note cleaned of site/season/hookup/booking text.
flags: Mostly seasonal: 'over 1100 sites with over 900 seasonal campsites' (operator's General Info page), plus a seasonal waiting list and a for-sale listing of seasonal sites. Nightly sites are under 200 (about 1 in 6); they are sold online on NewBook with posted 2026 nightly rates, so long-stay tests 2 and 4 pass.

Price gate: in season (April 16 - October 14) the cheapest site a 23-ft motorhome fits is water and electric at $55 a night (primitive $45 excluded as a primitive site), above US$50; only the April 1-15 and October 15-31 shoulder rate is $50. No gateway within 40 km (Detroit 100 km); the family has not stayed here.
